verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Claude Code can be piped into and run in CI [docs-7], with GitHub Actions and GitLab CI/CD integrations for automated code review and issue triage [docs-36, docs-12]. It also supports scheduled unattended runs [docs-8], auth via the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable with the approval prompt tied to interactive mode [docs-39, docs-40], and the Agent SDK for programmatic orchestration [docs-18]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the headless/non-interactive invocation flag and output formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
